stages.name: start ep001
stages.detail: Winnipeg (bear) (1914): the real bear behind Winnie-the-Pooh was a black bear cub bought for $20 at an Ontario train stop, who sailed for England with Canadian troops on October 3

stages.name: start ep002
stages.detail: Cher Ami (1918): the famous pigeon story says he was shot and lost a leg flying for the Lost Battalion on October 4, but the Signal Corps record puts his wounds weeks later

stages.name: start ep003
stages.detail: Axolotl: it can regrow limbs and even parts of its heart and brain, yet only about 50 to 1,000 adults are left in the wild
